name: name-and-role intro card
looks: On a near-black field, an italic serif greeting line fades in above a big bold name, with a small round accent bead sitting beside the last letter. A thin underline draws beneath it, and a short mono kicker line (role, one-word specialty, a founding year) settles in under that.
build: A DOM lockup: the italic greeting fades/rises in first (power2.out, ~300ms), the bold name follows close behind with a touch more weight, the bead pops in with a small scale overshoot, then the underline scales in from one end (scaleX 0 to 1) and the kicker line fades in last.
sound: A soft low swell as the lockup settles, with a light tick on the bead and the underline draw.
prompt: Open on a simple, confident name card: a soft italic greeting line above a bold display name, a small round accent mark beside it, a thin underline that draws on, and a short kicker line of role and specialty settling in beneath, all on a plain dark field.
